mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real GDP signals a strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following positive GDP growth, or GDP growth explains < 10% of SPX return variance over any 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate signals a rapidly weakening economy that will pressure corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5pp UNRATE spike, or the unemployment rate explains < 5% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production signals a supply shock that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 50% of months following a 1% INDPRO drop, or INDPRO explains < 2% of SPX return variance over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate signals a monetary tightening cycle that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5pp FEDFUNDS hike, or the federal funds rate explains < 10% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts signals a weakening consumer sector that will pressure corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 5% HOUST drop, or HOUST explains < 5% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in payroll employment signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following positive PAYEMS growth, or PAYEMS explains < 10% of SPX return variance over any 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in retail sales signals a strengthening consumer sector that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 50% of months following a 1% RSAFS rise, or RSAFS explains < 5% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index signals rising inflation expectations that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 50% of months following a 0.5pp CPI rise, or CPI explains < 2% of SPX return variance over any 2-year window.
